<!-- nativecmpkit-resolution:UI-004:20261028-important-direct -->
## Verified resolution — UTC 2026-10-28
The original three acceptance requirements have been reviewed and pass for the owning bounds policy:

1. Direct reversed days, reversed intraday endpoints within one UTC day, and disjoint composed rules: the actual Material `DateStateContractTest.emptyBoundsAndSameDayIntradayEndpointsAreDistinct` passes at immutable `9608ca19896fef3f48bcc8e6e983a7619aa6b77f`, together with native backend checks and the public changing-rule scenario.
2. Actual attached native inline/compact/wheels/range controls disable on empty bounds without installing a reversed UIKit interval, preserve explicit disabled state, and recover to nonempty bounds. Reused backend methods passed in [40702873405](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/40702873405) at `6e21cf38356909e22444c6fa9771961388b93209`; the repaired public inline/wheels/range scenario passes in [40716564702](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/40716564702) at `71b19242bda60ef0e6346c6b7c5b702d67e4310b`.
3. Actual UIKit min/max 1900..2100 and all null-bound combinations pass in those two unchanged backend methods; the UTC year-start/leap/pre-epoch contract passes in the focused desktop run.

Owning fix: `DateBounds.isEmpty` uses canonical UTC-day semantics; `UIDatePickerBackend.applyDateBounds` clears prior endpoints and disables empty sets; `CalendarViewHost.applyDateBounds` keeps the previous safe interval while the rule rejects every date. Nonempty recovery never overrides requested disabled state. APIs remain additive and useful empty intersections remain representable.

Reviewed counts: focused desktop **3/3**, one fresh XML, exit 0/51.02 s and all 795 immutable before/after inputs held. Native recovery **7 executed, 6 pass, 1 unrelated compact replacement failure**, two fresh XML, command exit 1; all 793 immutable inputs held, native application protocol/XML agree and owned application/Worker cleanup verified. The two original backend passes are **reused**, not new executions.
Verification scope: actual iPhone Air/iOS 26.5 simulator, Xcode 26.6 and JDK 17; no physical/minimum-OS, accessibility, heap, ABI, whole-library consumer, dependency/legal/security or release certification. Native endpoint checks exercise the default 1900..2100 range, not every custom year range. The two original failed workflows remain failed; their individual passed cases are reused only after matching owning production/test/helper/build inputs. No successful native cases were replayed. #119/UI-003 remains open for its failed compact appearance assertion. Public Calf packages and original finding/history are preserved. No publication, deployment or subagents.

Important tests → source/results review → direct closure. Detailed evidence is added to the development branch after this closure, not used as a reason to delay it.
